IN THE COURT OF HONOURABLE ADDL. JUDICIAL FIRST CLASS MAGISTRATE AT SANGAREDDY

Honored Sir/Madam,  

The brief facts of the case are that on 02-01-2024 at 15:00 hours, I, SI of Police, Sangareddy Rural PS received credible information that some persons are keeping Explosive Substances at Sri Laxmi Narsimha Stones & Rocks Pvt. Limited, Erdanur village. Accordingly I along with my staff raided on Sri Laxmi Narsimha Stones & Rocks Pvt. Limited, Erdanur village along with two panch witnesses i.e., (1) Sri. Lakavath Kumar Naik s/o Man Singh, age: 30 yrs, caste: ST (Lambada), occ: Business, R/o: H.No. 7-41, Gudithanda village, Sangareddy mandal & district and (2) Sri. Darshanam Srihari s/o Sudarshan, age: 35 yrs, caste: SC (Madiga), occ: Business, R/o: Mamidipally village, Kandi mandal, Sangareddy district and found (1) 44 boxes contained 8800 gelatin sticks, and loose 100 gelatin sticks, grand total 8900 gelatin sticks. These gelatin sticks are having in orange colour and each one having 8 inches height and 1 inch dia. There gelatin sticks are used as blasting substances and also found (2) 21 packets of electrical detonators, each packet having 50 electrical detonators and loose 60 electrical detonators. Grand total 1110 electrical detonators are found and also found (3) 17 MS Delay Detonators in the old damaged mini goods vehicle bearing number AP16TB7273. The accused persons (1) Raghuvaran, SR mining, (2) Bhoom Reddy, Sahasra Enterprises and (3) Aadi Vishnu, Minings Engineer and Safety Manager were preserved the above explosive substances without having any permission and license from the concerning authority. If the above explosive substances blast, it is endanger to the life of surrounding residents. Further I have seized all the above explosive substances along with the mini goods vehicle in the presence of above said two mediators under a cover of scene of offence cum seizure panchanama and pasted their signed paper slips on them.   

Returned to PS on 02-01-2024 at 18.30 hours 

               Basing on the scene of offence cum seizure panchanama, I, SIP Sangareddy Rural registered a Sue-Motto Case in Cr. No. 3/2024 U/s 5 & 6 of Explosive Substance Act 1908 and took up the investigation. (The Original Scene of offence cum seizure Panchanama is enclosed here with).

                                                                                                  M. Rajesh Naik
                                                                                             Sub-Inspector of Police,
                                                                                                 Sangareddy Rural P.S.

IN THE COURT OF HONOURABLE XVII ADDL CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE, AT NAMPALLY HYDERABAD.
Honored Sir,
The facts of the case are that today i.e., on 30-11-2023 at 1000 hrs received a complaint from Smt. Syeda Meher Fatima W/o. Md. Aijaz Ahmed Hashmi, Age: 42 yrs, Occ: Private Teacher, R/o. H.No.10-3-193/11, Flat No.202, MMQ Enclave, Humayun Nagar, Hyderabad, Cell No.9177165695. In which she stated they are three sisters and one brother to their parents. About (10) years back her parents died. In the year-2014 her younger sister by name Syeda Meraj Fatima, Age 40 yrs, Occ: Dietician in Rainbow Hospital, Jubilee Hills, got married to Syed Ahmed Quadri and they are residing at Flat No.201, Pioneer Enclave, Satya colony, Gate No.2, Shaikpet, Film Nagar, Hyderabad on rent. Syed Ahmed Quadri is a doing real estate business. Since their marriage, her younger sister is not having any children. Upon which Syed Ahmed Quadri always argued with her sister, saying that she is looking very ugly and not in a position to give birth to children. Earlier, her sister informed the complainant and her husband, her elder sister by name Syeda Muneer Fatima that her husband Syed Ahmed Quadri is harassing her mentally and physically telling that she is not good looking. On this, they advised her sister to take divorce from her husband but her sister did not listen their words by telling that he would harm them all. Sometimes her sister revealed them that, if she reveals the issue, her husband might harm their families. On 29.11.2023 at 2030 hrs the complainant contacted her sister through her phone but her sister Meraj Fatima did not receive her calls, upon which she along with her husband, and elder sister by name Syeda Muneer Fatima reached Syeda Meraj Fatima’s residence but her house main door was locked. They tried to contact from their phones to Syed Ahmed Quadri but he didn’t lift their calls. Then they returned to their respective homes. They kept trying and could not contact her and found her phone was switched off. So, again they went to her home but found the main door was locked and a LPG gas leaked smell came out from the house. Immediately, they broke opened the main door lock and went inside the house and switched off the gas stove. Later, they looked in all the rooms and suddenly they touched the hand of her sister which was under big heap of clothes covered with the mat in a room on the floor. After removing the said clothes, the complainant found her sister lying with brown coloured chunni around her neck on the floor. Later, the Police came and shifted her dead body to Osmania General Hospital through 108 Ambulance. The complainant strongly suspects that, her sister’s husband by name Syed Ahmed Quadri might have murdered her younger sister. Hence, she requested to take necessary action against Syed Ahmed Quadri.

(Original Complaint copy is enclosed herewith)
Received complaint on 30-11-2023 at 1000 hours:-
 As per the contents of the above complaint, I, M.G.S Ramakrishna, SHO of PS Film Nagar registered a case in Cr.No. 519/2023 U/Sec. 302, 498 (A), 201 IPC and took up the investigation.
          Sd/-
M.G.S Ramakrishna,
Inspector of Police,
Film Nagar PS, Hyd.
